purpose: Design, implement, reconstruct, and audit ambitious AXIGNAL UI and UX motion with GSAP while preserving product truth, accessibility, performance, lifecycle safety, and user control.
inputs: A user request, interaction brief, reference, or existing AXIGNAL interface to audit.
The active AXIGNAL task, phase, Goal Lock, and governing contracts.
Current UI source, design tokens, framework, package manager, and dependency state.
Target device, accessibility, multilingual, and performance constraints.
outputs: A semantic motion brief with interruption, reduced-motion, and fallback behavior.
A scoped GSAP implementation or implementation-ready interaction specification.
Automated and browser acceptance evidence covering lifecycle, accessibility, semantics, and performance.
Known limitations, rollback instructions, and an independent-gate handoff.
prohibited_actions: Override AXIGNAL-GOAL-001, canonical identity, repository contracts, or explicit user direction.
Use motion to imply financial certainty, urgency, suitability, truth, coverage, freshness, or expected return without a declared canonical variable.
Hide evidence, contradictions, unknowns, provenance, as-of state, or critical interaction behind animation.
Override reduced-motion, keyboard, focus, high-contrast, screen-reader, or multilingual requirements.
Ship unscoped selectors, stale ScrollTriggers, leaked listeners, SSR browser calls, production markers, or GSDevTools.
Add a private GreenSock registry, an auth token, a secret, or an unpinned runtime dependency.
Freeze provisional design or motion tokens without the required evidence and accepted ADR.
Self-approve a material design direction or phase gate.

tests.description: The Skill passes the Codex Skill structure and frontmatter validator.
The deterministic motion auditor accepts a compliant React fixture and rejects unsafe GSAP patterns.
The typed Skill contract validates against schemas/skill.schema.json.
All active Skill artifacts pass the canonical AXIGNAL naming validator.

deactivation.kill_switch: Set the registry state to REVOKED or remove the Skill from task routing before the next agent run.
deactivation.rollback: Revert the Skill directory and its registry/map entries; no runtime GSAP dependency is introduced by this Skill contract.
